sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We deeply value our long-standing partnership and welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract.
We can offer a revised price of €51.80, provided the new agreement takes effect on 1 January 2027.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €51.40 per unit.
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your revised offer; it is encouraging to see us moving closer to an agreement. Our traditional foundry has long valued the strong, reliable partnership between our companies, and it is a matter of personal pride for us to work together toward a shared future.

In recognition of your movement, I am prepared to lower our price to €51.30 for the 24-month contract with 30-day payment terms starting in April 2027. To be precise, our current Angebot stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We have always valued our reliable partnership, and I am confident this step brings us to a fair conclusion.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with your house. We value our long-standing partnership and remain committed to reaching an agreement that works for both our houses.

In response to your flexibility, I am pleased to lower our price to €50.90 for the 24-month contract starting in April 2027. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot provides a price of €50.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 April 2027. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days. Our team here in the foundry takes great pride in the quality we deliver to our partners in the region, and we hope to continue our successful collaboration for years to come.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
